_about: Wait clock numbers, in seconds. first_check_seconds: when a wait is first checked. interval_seconds: how often it is checked after that. stalled_after_quiet_checks: how many checks in a row with no new output before a wait counts as stalled. foreground_limit_seconds: the longest a command may hold the turn in the foreground; longer ones must run in the background. deadline_seconds: the longest each kind of wait may run before it is given up on (command, agent, build, ci). Environment variables HOUSE_RULES_WAIT_* override each number.
